title: Targeting quorum sensing in Pseudomonas aeruginosa with high-affinity inhibitors: A high-throughput screening and in-silico analysis.
authors: Abbas, Sidra; Mujawar, Shama; Yasmin, Azra; Perveen, Shaghufta; Malik, Parvez Azam; Gill, Muhammad Shoaib Ali; Chohan, Tahir Ali
one_liner_zh: 该研究针对铜绿假单胞菌LasR蛋白筛选小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a major pathogen in clinical settings, notorious for its intrinsic resistance to multiple antibiotics and ability to form biofilms, therefore, complicating treatment. This study reporting the results of a high-throughput screen of an antibacterial library targeting LasR, a key QS regulator in P. aeruginosa MB638, isolated from an infected surgical implant. The species identity was confirmed as P. aeruginosa via 16S rDNA analysis (accession number MT643188). The strain demonstrated strong biofilm formation and multidrug resistance, along with significant production of the quorum sensing signalling molecule N-(3-oxododecanoyl)-L-homoserine lactone (OdDHL). We screened a  approximately 1400-compound library and identified inhibitors compounds that surpass the binding affinity of LasR's native ligand. The ADMET analysis revealed that among these, compounds Inh-1, Inh-2 and Inh-3 demonstrated favourable absorption, permeability and broader bioactivity profiles. Inh-1 exhibited a suitable profile, being non-toxic, non-hepatotoxic, and non-mutagenic, with low carcinogenic and immunotoxin potential. Molecular docking studies using GLIDE identified key binding interactions and residues within the LasR ligand-binding domain (LBD), with Inh-1, Inh-2 and Inh-3 showing the highest binding affinities and favourable docking scores of -14.587, -13.645 and -12.967, respectively. Structural Interaction Molecular dynamics simulation at 100 ns showed Inh-1 maintained stable hydrophobic and hydrophilic contacts within the active site. RMSD analysis confirmed the stability of the Inh-1 complex, while RMSF indicated conformational adaptability. Inh-1 stands out as promising lead for LasR inhibition, warranting further experimental study. These inhibitors hold promise for disrupting quorum sensing in P. aeruginosa and may serve as potential therapeutic agent against resistant infections.
abstract_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）是临床环境中的主要病原体，以其对多种抗生素的内在耐药性及形成生物膜的能力而著称，从而使治疗复杂化。本研究报道了一项针对LasR（一种从感染手术植入物中分离的P. aeruginosa MB638中的关键群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）调节因子）的抗菌化合物库的高通量筛选结果。通过16S rDNA分析（登录号MT643188）确认该物种为P. aeruginosa。该菌株表现出强大的生物膜形成能力和多重耐药性，并显著产生群体感应信号分子N-(3-氧代十二烷酰)-L-高丝氨酸内酯（OdDHL）。我们筛选了约含1400种化合物的库，并鉴定出超越LasR天然配体结合亲和力的抑制剂化合物。ADMET分析显示，其中化合物Inh-1、Inh-2和Inh-3表现出良好的吸收性、渗透性和更广泛的生物活性特征。Inh-1展现出合适的特性，具有非毒性、非肝毒性、非致突变性，且致癌和免疫毒素潜力低。使用GLIDE进行的分子对接研究确定了LasR配体结合域（LBD）内的关键结合相互作用和残基，其中Inh-1、Inh-2和Inh-3显示出最高的结合亲和力，对接分数分别为-14.587、-13.645和-12.967。100 ns的结构相互作用分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示，Inh-1在活性位点内保持稳定的疏水和亲水接触。RMSD分析确认了Inh-1复合物的稳定性，而RMSF则表明构象适应性。Inh-1作为LasR抑制的潜在先导化合物脱颖而出，值得进一步的实验研究。这些抑制剂有望破坏P. aeruginosa的群体感应，并可能作为对抗耐药性感染的潜在治疗剂。
